reading.action: Tear free of the Glut's grip and scramble out of the water to the walkway/descending stair
reading.result: FREE — clean escape. Heated bar made the leeches recoil (fire-gate), leg-drive (Hiker's Legs) tore the calf loose, scrambled onto dry stone. No drowning-pull damage (margin 12). Now on the walkway near the descending stair; the Glut mounds at the waterline, unable to pursue onto dry stone (strand-gate revealed diegetically, not told). HP 58 unchanged; Stamina 40->34 (hard scramble); Focus 48->44 (channel sustain).
